claim_boundary: AskFRED-derived published event-result entries from 2002-2022, not a USA Fencing membership census. The source itself documents incomplete queries, senior/open-event selection, parsing errors, and post-2020 disruption. Names are pseudonymized; clubs, locations, and event titles are removed from the local analytic table. Exact repeats, missing athlete rows, impossible placements, and reversed date ranges are excluded. No repository license was found, so row-level data and derivatives remain local.
license: No repository license; local analysis only
